title: Peanut Butter Energy Balls
blurb: No-bake bites packed with peanut butter, honey and dried fruit, rolled in toasted coconut and sesame seeds.
steps: Mix the peanut butter and honey together in a large bowl until smooth and combined.
Stir in the raisins and half the sesame seeds until evenly distributed through the mixture.
Cover the bowl and chill in the fridge for at least two hours until firm enough to shape.
Mix the remaining sesame seeds with the desiccated coconut on a plate.
Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of the chilled mixture and roll into balls with your hands.
Roll each ball in the coconut and sesame coating until covered, then arrange on a tray.
Chill the coated balls for another 30 minutes before serving or storing in an airtight container in the fridge.
